entities.summary: Julian Melchiori is a Canadian professional ice hockey defenceman who is currently playing with Grizzlys Wolfsburg in the Deutsche Eishockey Liga (DEL). He was selected in the third round, 87th overall, in the 2010 NHL Entry Draft by the Atlanta Thrashers.
